text.en:
Reclassification of lands to be reclaimed. In compliance with
applicable laws, rules, regulations and procedures, the DENR shall perform all the
necessary acts to reclassify portions of the land to be reclaimed as alienable and
disposable land of the public domain.
Office ofthe President of the Philiopines
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

Creation of an Inter-Agency Technical Committee (IATC).
There is hereby created an lATC composed of technical representatives of the
DPWH, the LLDA, the DENR, and the PRA, to perform the following:
Assist the DPWH and LLDA in the implementation of the LLEDP and in
resolving issues arising from the implementation of the LLEDP; and
Ensure that all aspects of the LLEDP, including the relocation of the
LLEDP-affected inhabitants, waste management, reclamation,
environmental protection, property development, and construction, are
consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws, rules and
regulations.

Repeal. All orders, issuances, or parts thereof, which are
inconsistent with the provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Order is declared invalid or
unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and
subsisting.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this s22ndday of March
Lord Two Thousand and Sixteen.
